name: Full_Provenance_Chain
description: Full provenance chain of biospecimen IDs, each link separated by a pointer (-->).

name: Depth_Prov_Chain
description: Number of provenance relationships traversed from the assayed biospecimen to its originating source.

name: HTAN_ASSAYED_BIOSPECIMEN_ID
description: HTAN Biospecimen ID of the biospecimen directly assayed using the experimental platform.

name: HTAN_ORIGINATING_BIOSPECIMEN_ID
description: HTAN Biospecimen ID of the biopsied or resected biospecimen from the patient from which the assay data were derived.

name: BIOSPECIMEN_PATH
description: Full Biospecimen ancestry path from HTAN_ASSAYED_BIOSPECIMEN_ID to HTAN_ORIGINATING_BIOSPECIMEN_ID as comma separated list.
